lemmas.primary_translation: to know what to expect from someone

definitions.text: vite hva en kan vente av noen
definitions.translation: to know what to expect from someone (lit. to know where one has someone)

examples.no: de vet hvor de har ham og slipper å lure på hva han tenker og gjør
examples.en: they know what to expect from him and do not have to wonder what he thinks and does

examples.no: hun er en slik som en ikke vet hvor en har
examples.en: she is the kind of person one does not know what to expect from
